text:
alex: Quick heads-up: release train check-in. We discovered a tail-latency regression in the new batching heuristic during canary. Short summary + proposed mitigation below.

priya: thanks alex. is this impacting all regions?

alex: primarily NA and APAC model-serving lanes. EU saw minimal impact.

ops-bot: Canary event: train-2026-03-25-3830001111 started on na-east1 (group=beta, 5%). Dashboard: https://ci.redwood/release/3830001111/canary

tom: 15m into canary: error rate jumped to 0.45% (baseline 0.03), p99 latency +85ms. Suspect heuristic misfires on short-context requests.

elena: flagging customer-facing endpoints that route small prompts. @customer-success: expect brief blips.

alex: proposed plan: 1) pause further rollout, 2) apply hotfix to revert heuristic to v1 behavior on canary hosts, 3) extend release freeze on infra/deployment changes until 2026-03-29T23:59Z. Minor non-infra patches still allowed with release-lead signoff.

priya: concur. who owns the hotfix?

tom: I'll wire the revert patch (PR #5630) and push to hotfix branch once reviewers OK.

ops-bot: Canary update: na-east1 group beta 1m: errors 0.38%, p99 78ms. No new crash loops.

elena: reminder: rollback checklist in runbook sec 4.2. Quick snippet for rollback exec: 
```
./runbook rollback --train=3830001111 --target=v2.8
```

alex: action items: tom to land hotfix, priya to coordinate with SRE to hold APAC promo, elena to prepare CS note, ops to monitor metrics for next 60m.

priya: started an incident channel: #release-3830001111-incident for live triage.

ops-bot: APAC preflight: blocked due to elevated kv.evictions and batch-tail spikes. Holding regional cutover.

elena: for freeze exemptions, please run: 
```
/flake-exempt --ticket=JIRA-1234 --owner=@yourname --reason="urgent migration"
```

alex: decision: hold global rollout. NA canary continues at 5% until hotfix verifies. No schema changes or infra toggles until Monday 2026-03-29 UTC.

priya: noted. I'll update the release calendar and notify partner teams.

tom: PR #5630 pushed to hotfix branch; pinging reviewers now.

ops-bot: Canary health check 40m: errors 0.22%, p99 52ms.

elena: if errors exceed 0.6% for a sustained 10m window we abort and roll back immediately.

alex: thanks team. If you're oncall this weekend and see noise from this train, page priya first. I'll post a short summary once hotfix lands. :loud_sound:
